tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List catalogue categories with the number of products in each.

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products from the SalesBeat cosmetics catalogue, optionally filtered by category or a name/code search term.

search.description: Case-insensitive text matched against product name and code.

category.description: Category filter: Eye, Face, Lip, Hair or Nail Care.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 50).

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get full catalogue details for one product by its id or product code, including pricing, unit, shades and stock defaults.

idOrCode.description: Product id (e.g. p1) or product code (e.g. EGML 6008 DD).
